title: Loop runs one past the end of a list
Concatenating str and int
code:
age = 25
message = "I am " + age + " years old"
print(message)
reference_fix:
age = 25
message = "I am " + str(age) + " years old"
print(message)

title: Variable name typo
code:
total_price = 100
discount = 10
final_price = total_price - discount
print(final_prce)
reference_fix:
total_price = 100
discount = 10
final_price = total_price - discount
print(final_price)

title: Counter is never incremented
code:
total = 0
count = 0
for n in [10, 20, 30]:
    total += n
average = total / count
print(average)
reference_fix:
total = 0
count = 0
for n in [10, 20, 30]:
    total += n
    count += 1
average = total / count
print(average)

title: Slice starts one element too early
> instead of >=
code:
def is_adult(age):
    # 18 and older counts as an adult
    if age > 18:
        return True
    return False

print(is_adult(18))
print(is_adult(25))
reference_fix:
def is_adult(age):
    # 18 and older counts as an adult
    if age >= 18:
        return True
    return False

print(is_adult(18))
print(is_adult(25))

title: Loop variable never changes
code:
total = 0
i = 1
while i <= 5:
    total += i
print(total)
reference_fix:
total = 0
i = 1
while i <= 5:
    total += i
    i += 1
print(total)

title: Removing items while iterating
reference_fix:
numbers = [2, 4, 6, 7]
numbers = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]
print(numbers)  # should keep only the odd numbers

title: Function forgets to return
code:
def square(x):
    result = x * x

value = square(4)
print(value + 1)
reference_fix:
def square(x):
    result = x * x
    return result

value = square(4)
print(value + 1)

title: Nested key read from the wrong level
Extra argument in a call
code:
def power(base, exponent):
    return base ** exponent

# 2 to the power of 3
print(power(2, 3, 4))
reference_fix:
def power(base, exponent):
    return base ** exponent

# 2 to the power of 3
print(power(2, 3))

title: Modifying a global without declaring it
code:
counter = 0

def increment():
    counter += 1
    return counter

print(increment())
reference_fix:
counter = 0

def increment():
    global counter
    counter += 1
    return counter

print(increment())
